title: Ceasefire
text: “Now is the time for the world to fight the waves—not for Melromarc and Siltvelt to be at odds.”
“But, Foxess of Melromarc! What do you intend to do about the Three Heroes Church running amok?”

“I believe information regarding that has already reached you. The Three Heroes Church has been designated as traitors to the state, and Melromarc—with the Shield Hero’s support—will convert to the Four Holy Sects… No, judging by the people’s reaction, it might actually become the Shield Sect.”

As if the outcome were already decided, the queen closed her eyes tightly as she replied. Even as she spoke, stray arrows and Magic spells nearly struck, but my Father expanded his Shooting Star Shield to protect us.

It’s only a matter of time before the allied forces the Queen brought with her capture the Melromarc army. The Shusaku race ordered the Siltvelt army to cease fire and remain on standby. Just then, a shadow appeared and relayed information to the Queen and the Shusaku race.

“It seems that the Pope of the Three Heroes Church—not to mention the senior members of the Three Heroes Church who were in Melromarc’s town—have all been wiped out by the Spear Hero, who was lured out by that despicable trap.”
“So, does that mean we just have to wait for Motoyasu-kun to come over here? Your Majesty, if you don’t return to the castle, the revolution will…”

“It seems that matter has already been resolved as well. I’ve heard that my daughter, Melty, desperately persuaded the revolutionary army. No, to be precise, it seems she managed to subdue my husband, Aultcray.”
“Melty-chan!? I told her to stay behind and mind the castle…”
“It seems she took a bit of a risk. Since the outcome was favorable, everything turned out all right… but in any case, I can only pray that this commotion will finally die down.”
After saying this, the Queen closed her fan and bowed her head to Father.
“I am truly sorry for the situation this has caused due to my misconduct, and I am deeply sorry for my daughter Malty’s actions—not to mention Aultcray’s outrageous behavior.”
“Ah… yes. It was… very difficult.”
“Thank you so much for ridding our country of this festering sore. I can only imagine how grueling and arduous that journey must have been.”
“No, it’s just… I had some reliable comrades with me.”
“Hehe!”
Apparently, Keel made a point of asserting himself quite ostentatiously.
“My big bro really gave it his all! More importantly, Your Majesty, you should teach the nobles and soldiers of this country the difference between right and wrong a little better.”
“Keel, I understand how you feel, but…”

“I have no words to reply. After all, it was a policy that had been passed down through generations, so reform didn’t progress, and this outcome was inevitable… However, thanks to the Shield Hero, I believe our country has finally reached a time of transformation.”
From the Queen’s candid response, it seems Keel also sensed that the Queen herself wasn’t at fault.
“Is that so? Then can my village be rebuilt too?”
“Yes. I promise we’ll provide as much aid as we possibly can.”
“Whoa! Yay!”
“It was Keel’s dream, after all.”
“Yeah!”
It seems I arrived just as they were having that conversation.
“Well, that’s how the war came to a ceasefire in no time at all.”
“Is that so?”

It seems the situation was quite dire, but they managed to put a stop to the civil war in Melromarc and Siltvelt’s advance. I can’t help but feel it was a bit forceful, but fortunately, the high-ranking officials on the Siltvelt side fully understood the meaning behind Father’s words.
If the Shield Cult—which worships my Father—had been as extremist as the Three Heroes Church, things would have been a complete disaster. I suppose I should ask about that just to be safe?
“Does the state religion of Siltvelt avoid the kind of reckless behavior seen in the Three Heroes Church?”
“Motoyasu… aren’t you being a little too blunt?”
My father tried to rein me in, but the two representatives from Siltvelt—the Shusaku and Genmu clans—seemed unfazed as they replied.
“The extremists there were defeated in the past by the Wise King.”
“The truth is, even we as representatives want to avoid that kind of rampage. Since we’re pursuing a policy of friendship with the Queen of Melromarc, the extremists’ influence has been waning.”
“……I see.”

You never know what might turn out to be a blessing. Does this mean that the Trash of the past have eroded any willingness in Siltvelt to consider all-out war? Beyond that, the Queen of Melromarc must have used her silver tongue to somehow rein in Siltvelt’s reckless behavior.

I’ve heard that it was common knowledge that my Father had been active within the country and had gained people’s trust. So Siltvelt remained silent because of the movement to change Melromarc from within. This time, the runaway behavior was caused by loyalty to the Father, and after being stopped by him—and effectively having cold water poured on them—they’ve settled down.

Since Siltvelt has also experienced the threat of the Waves, I suppose it’s not entirely incomprehensible. Both the residents of Melromarc and those from regions that have experienced the Waves have come to recognize the importance of your Father. As the threat of the Waves grows more severe, extreme religious beliefs and discrimination will only get in the way.

While there may still be some resentment, the fact that her Father was making a name for himself in an enemy nation likely served to vent the people’s frustration. As for further attacks… given that the representative of the Shusaku clan also understood they would be detrimental in light of the political situation in each country, and since Melromarc had led the Allied Forces to capture the rogue troops, it was decided to call it a day here.
“So it was a compromise, then.”
“Motoyasu, you really should have been a little more tactful in how you spoke… Well, never mind.”
“Information from the castle is also pouring in here. You can consider the dark side of the Three Heroes Church to have been almost entirely exposed.”

The Queen is pointing out that the Pope I killed was secretly harboring replicas of the Hero’s weapons and had swapped out the ritual artifacts used to summon the Hero. As a result, the Three Heroes Church has been designated both a heretical cult and a traitorous organization. By identifying a common enemy, we’ve managed to avoid war.

So, with that… we’ve arrived in the town of Melromarc, where traces of the revolution still remain. The revolutionary forces throughout Melromarc and the townspeople are welcoming my Father, the Queen, the representative from Siltvelt, and us. A new nation is about to be reborn right here.

News that a faction of the Siltvelt Army had gone rogue and was attempting to attack Melromarc spread instantly throughout the country, and the whole nation is abuzz with rumors about the Shield Hero who stopped them. Furthermore, the nobles who weren’t part of the revolutionary faction had already lost much of their power during the revolution, so Melromarc has effectively established a system where even the Shield Hero is worshipped as a god.
And then… slipping through the open castle gates, we arrived at the throne room. There, my fiancée was waiting with Sakura-chan. Where’s that Trash?
“Shield Hero!”
My fiancée and Sakura-chan rush over to my Father, but he scolds her with a worried look.
“Melty-chan, I was so worried about you!　Also… you broke your promise to me, didn’t you?”
“Ah… um… yes.”
Stammering slightly, my Finacée answered honestly.
“Well… I understand that from your perspective, you had no choice but to do it. But personally, I wish you hadn’t taken such a risk.”
“W-why is that?”
“It’s obvious—because I was worried about you, isn’t it?”
“…Y-yes, I suppose so.”

My fiancée’s cheeks flushed slightly. Hmm? What’s with this reaction? After all, my fiancée has someone named Filo-tan in her life. Even as I pondered this, the conversation between my future Father and my fiancée continued.
“No matter how much Sakura-chan says she’ll protect you, what would we have done if something had happened to you, Melty-chan?”
“B-but… this is my mother’s country, and I wanted to tell my father the truth. I can’t stand by and watch the country fall into even more chaos.”

“Even so… you’re a princess of this important country, aren’t you? If anything happened to you, not only your father, but your mother, me, and everyone else would be heartbroken. So, you absolutely mustn’t do anything reckless anymore.”
Saying this, my future Father gently admonished my Finacée and smiled kindly.
“But you did a great job. How did you stop the revolution?”

“Um… After the Shield Hero and the Spear Hero left, another message arrived saying that if things continued this way, Melromarc would be destroyed. It urged them to come to the church in Melromarc immediately…”
“That’s a blatant trap, isn’t it?”
“Otherwise, the message said they would assassinate the Wise King… After that, troops from the Three Heroes Church arrived.”
“So their plan was to kill me, and then take out my Finacée and Itsuki.”
The Three Heroes Church really will stop at nothing. However, judging by these developments, it seems Itsuki was in serious danger as well.
“Wyndia and Gaelion tried to protect us, but I just couldn’t stand by and do nothing…”
“Then what about Wyndia and Gaelion!? What happened to Itsuki!?”
“There’s no need to worry about that.”
Just then, Ren arrived with a clearly displeased Itsuki.
“Ren!?”
“‘What are you doing here?’ Is that what you’re asking?”

When my Father and I nodded, Ren began to explain the situation. On the day he was supposed to meet up with my Father and the others, while waiting at the designated spot, he was told to accompany someone claiming to be my Father’s messenger. When he followed them, he was apparently lured into a trap.
“The twist is that he was actually a member of the Three Heroes Church. Apparently, he’d been eavesdropping on a conversation I had with my comrades in Zeltoble.”
“H-how did you escape?”
“I was rescued by someone from the Queen’s faction—the ‘Shadow,’ or whatever they’re called. After that, I’ve been operating in secret.”
“H-huh…”

Rin, looking quite smug, was joined by his Assistant and Rival, who seemed rather displeased to be there, as they arrived from behind. It seems like the Three Heroes Church’s schemes backfired completely, doesn’t it?
“It looks like Itsuki’s friends were being used by the Three Heroes Church, too. They were apparently forced to participate in the operation to rescue Itsuki.”
“S-so, did Motoyasu-kun’s Magic wipe them all out at once?”
“What are you talking about? They’re right over there.”
Ren is pointing at a group of people who look like Itsuki’s friends. Looks like there’s a stalker pig in the mix, too.
